reason: It has no reviews yet, and I won't put a new tool on client sites until other people have shown it works on real ones. I'd also only need full-site screenshots a few times a year, so a monthly plan doesn't fit. I'd try the free tier once and leave it at that.
objection: Nobody has reviewed it yet, and the free tier is desktop only. Mobile is the part I actually care about, so I can't test it properly before I pay.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from other freelancers, plus a free trial that includes iPhone and Android captures so I can see it handle one of my clients' sites first. After that I'd consider the $99 lifetime plan.
